issuer: the New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)
note: The DMV's fee table (read 2026-10-30) gives a Class D licence and learner permit together, for an applicant 21 and older, as $64.25 to $67.50, or $73.25 to $77.50 with the Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District fee paid by residents of New York City's five counties and seven counties around it; the fee is kept as $77.50, the full 8-year term in the district, where most of the state lives and where a performer would. The table's refund section names the licence's 8-year term. The manual says Class D is held from 18, or 17 with a driver education certificate (Class DJ, the junior licence, from 16), so a full licence is kept from 18. The non-driver ID fee page gives a standard card, under 62, for 4 years at $10.00 or 8 years at $14.00 (more than 6 months before the next birthday), both held as terms the holder chooses; a person of any age can get one, so the card has no age. Not held: the licence's shorter terms and their prices, the $30 enhanced licence, the cards for holders on SSI or temporary assistance. On 2026-10-30 the file was rewritten with the terms the holder chooses among: until then the card was the 8-year one at $14.00 only. Later on 2026-10-30 the card's terms were given the ages they're sold to, from the same table of standard cards: 4 and 8 years under 62, and 10 years at $6.50 from 62.

sources.title: New York DMV, Driver License and Learner Permit Fees and Refunds
sources.said: 21 and older $64.25 - $67.50 $73.25 - $77.50* ... * Includes MCTD ... The MCTD fee is $1.00 for every 6 months the permit or driver license will be in effect. ... the original 8-year driver license fee

sources.title: New York State Driver's Manual, Chapter 1: Driver Licenses
sources.said: Operator, Class D - Minimum age is 18, or age 17 with a driver education Certificate of Completion ... Junior Operator, Class DJ - Minimum age is 16.

sources.title: New York DMV, Non-Driver ID Fees
sources.said: Under age 62, your next birthday is more than 6 months away 4 years $10.00 ... Under age 62, your next birthday is more than 6 months away 8 years $14.00 ... Age 62 or older 10 years $6.50

sources.title: New York DMV, Non-Driver ID Cards
sources.said: A person of any age can get a non-driver ID card.
